text:
Ravi: Clearing out some gear before my move - free standing desk converter (Jarvis-style riser) + used Herman Miller Sayl chair (armrests a bit scuffed). Pickup Mission Bay office, I'll leave them by the community bench. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/xyz123
Nora: Ooh interested in the chair. Does the Sayl have lumbar support?
Ravi: It's the standard Sayl tilt + adjustable lumbar pad. Works great for 6+ hour coding days.
Ben: I could use the riser if Nora wants the chair. Happy to pick up Fri after 5pm.
liz-bot: FYI - please attach a sticky with your name + date when leaving items on the bench per office policy.
Ravi: Will do a label and leave my contact. Ben, if you can come Friday that's perfect. If Nora wants the chair, I'll hold it until EOD Fri for them.
Nora: Could you hold the chair until Monday morning? I'm heading out of town for the weekend.
Ben: No worries, I can do the riser Friday and help carry if needed. I can also pick up the chair on Monday if Nora passes.
Facilities: Bench D is fine for temporary pickups. Please don't block the aisle.
Ravi: Thanks @Facilities. I'll put both items on Bench D and tag them. Chair will have a sticky "HOLD for Nora until Mon 9am".
Nora: Thanks Ravi! DM incoming with desk details + my floor.
Ben: Also, heads up - the riser is heavy when fully extended. Two-person carry recommended. I'll bring my hand truck just in case.
Ravi: Good call. If someone needs help moving it, ping me and Ben.
Nora: If I end up not taking it, shout here and I'll free it up.
Ravi: Thanks y'all. If plans change I'll update the thread. :thumbsup:
